# IE University

> IE University is a leading institution fostering positive change through innovative education, research, and entrepreneurship across business, design, finance, and law disciplines.

IE University operates multiple campuses in Madrid and Segovia, Spain, serving a global community of 70,000+ alumni across five schools. The institution emphasizes humanistic values, entrepreneurial education, and university-industry collaboration through its Liquid Learning approach and strategic partnerships like CIVICA.
